Two carry-forwards for slice 012 recorded in close-out (S1 prd-<n> numbering space, S2 the pins are forward references). Committed as 652a018.

The three advisories the rulings did not speak to are fixed too — V01 now states that the values-path parameter carries the set D47 requires, P3 and V10 cite design.md:509 alongside :500-503, and G1's toolchain claim was already corrected in the adjudication commit. verification.json carries a new V12 for the slice-012 handoff; V05 and V06 restated.
